description: This Java class defines the 'FeatureDefinitionCreated' event, which is emitted after a feature's definition is created in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for constructing instances, JSON serialization/deserialization, and overrides for equality and string representation.

classes.name: FeatureDefinitionCreated
classes.description: Immutable event class representing the creation of a feature's definition, with JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and builder methods.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON string or object, deserializing the event.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Constructs a new event instance with specified parameters, including optional timestamp and metadata.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Returns the feature definition associated with the event.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the feature definition.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the feature's definition resource.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated headers.

methods.name: appendPayloadAndBuild
methods.description: Serializes the event payload into JSON.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on featureId and definition.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the object.
